blocks.text: 当 Amodei 家族成员待遇丰厚

inlines.text: 当 Amodei 家族成员待遇丰厚

blocks.text: 根据文件，联合创始人兄妹 Dario Amodei 和 Daniela Amodei 是 Anthropic 薪酬最高的两位高管。去年，首席执行官 Dario 的薪酬总额接近 1800 万美元，其中大部分来自股票和期权奖励。与此同时，总裁 Daniela 获得了 1640 万美元。诚然，这在大科技公司的薪酬标准中处于较低水平，但仍是一笔可观的数目。

blocks.text: Anthropic 面临一些相当关乎存续的风险因素

inlines.text: Anthropic 面临一些相当关乎存续的风险因素

blocks.text: 每份 S-1 文件都会列出一长串可能出问题的事项。Anthropic 也不例外。但除了关于竞争、监管和市场变化的常规警告之外，还有一些不那么传统的风险。

inlines.text: 每份 S-1 文件都会列出一长串可能出问题的事项。Anthropic 也不例外。但除了关于竞争、监管和市场变化的常规警告之外，还有一些不那么传统的风险。

blocks.text: 例如，Anthropic 警告称，AI 系统可能造成潜在的“灾难性”伤害，其严重程度甚至可能超出整个“保险行业合计”的承保能力。随着 AI 系统变得越来越复杂，还有一个问题：Claude——或任何其他 AI 系统——是否可能拥有或发展出“某种形式的意识”。这种情况将带来一些相当不寻常的商业挑战。此外，它们还“可能以意外、目标错位或自主的方式行事”，从而损害公司利益。

blocks.text: 它对算力如饥似渴

inlines.text: 它对算力如饥似渴

blocks.text: Anthropic 需要算力已不是秘密，但其支出规模之大令人震惊。文件详细列出了为获取驱动其 AI 模型所需的算力而做出的数十亿美元承诺，其中包括一旦所有计划产能交付后，每月向 SpaceX 支付约 31 亿美元以获取 Nvidia GPU，到 2029 年总额高达 1205 亿美元。其他承诺包括到 2033 年向 Microsoft 支出 449 亿美元，到 2033 年向 Google 支出至少 1145 亿美元，以及未来十年向 Amazon 支出 1100 亿美元。

blocks.text: 它的公司结构非常奇特

inlines.text: 它的公司结构非常奇特

blocks.text: Anthropic 作为一家公益公司，其公司结构本就有些复杂。但还有一个不同寻常的安排，将使其七位联合创始人即便在公司上市后仍能保留相当大的控制权。通过一家名为“Founder LLC”的独立公司实体，这七人将集体控制关键事项上 50.1% 的股东投票权。Anthropic 表示，这七位创始人“具备独特的资质，能够守护我们的使命”，即通过负责任的 AI 开发造福人类。

blocks.text: Anthropic has finally filed its S-1 prospectus with the SEC, a document designed to give investors a look under the hood of its business, from how much its executives are making and plans for spending its IPO billions to the risks that could derail its ambitions.

blocks.text: It pays to be an Amodei

inlines.text: It pays to be an Amodei

blocks.text: Sibling co-founders Dario Amodei and Daniela Amodei are the two most highly-paid executives at Anthropic, according to the filing. Last year, CEO Dario’s compensation totaled nearly $18 million, most of which came from stock and option awards. President Daniela, meanwhile, received $16.4 million. Admittedly, it is at the lower end of the Big Tech scale, but it is still a tidy sum.

blocks.text: And that’s not all. Anthropic also spent $2.75 million on “personal security services” for Dario and $1.29 million for “personal protection, home security, and transportation services” for Daniela. Dario also gets access to a private jet for personal use, which cost the company another $97,055.

blocks.text: Anthropic has some pretty existential risk factors

inlines.text: Anthropic has some pretty existential risk factors

blocks.text: Every S-1 features a long list of things that could go wrong. Anthropic’s is no exception. But alongside standard warnings about competition, regulation, and market shifts, there are some less conventional risks too.

inlines.text: Every S-1 features a long list of things that could go wrong. Anthropic’s is no exception. But alongside standard warnings about competition, regulation, and market shifts, there are some less conventional risks too.

blocks.text: For one, Anthropic warns that AI systems could cause potentially “catastrophic” harm, potentially of a kind that could not be underwritten by the entire “insurance industry in the aggregate.” As AI systems become more sophisticated, there’s also the question of whether Claude — or any other AI system — could possess or develop “forms of sentience.” Such a scenario would present some rather unusual business challenges. There’s also the possibility they “may behave in unintended, misaligned, or autonomous ways” that could damage the company.

blocks.text: It’s hungry for compute

inlines.text: It’s hungry for compute

blocks.text: It’s no secret that Anthropic needs compute, but the sheer scale of its spending is staggering. The filing details billions of dollars of commitments to secure the compute needed to power its AI models, including roughly $3.1 billion per month to SpaceX for access to Nvidia GPUs once all of the planned capacity is delivered, totaling as much as $120.5 billion by 2029. Other commitments include spending $44.9 billion with Microsoft through 2033, at least $114.5 billion with Google through 2033, and $110 billion with Amazon over the next ten years.

blocks.text: Anthropic also plans to expand its own “infrastructure footprint,” including overseas, as it faces increasing opposition to data center development in the US.

blocks.text: It has a really weird corporate structure

inlines.text: It has a really weird corporate structure

blocks.text: Anthropic already has a somewhat complicated corporate structure as a public benefit corporation. But there’s another unusual twist that will allow its seven cofounders to retain considerable control over the company even after it goes public. Through a separate corporate entity called “Founder LLC,” the group will collectively control 50.1 percent of shareholder voting power over key matters. Anthropic says the seven founders “are distinctly equipped to be stewards of our mission” of benefiting humanity through responsible AI development.

blocks.text: There’s no shortage of AI models out there, but when it comes to “direct competition,” Anthropic names just two other developers: OpenAI and Google. Condolences to SpaceX, Meta, and the rest of the AI world.
